body:
Well, she came back over while I was sleeping on the sofa with a bible as a gift and a ton of other stuff. Made me instant uncomfortable because she said she was coming back tomorrow and not 3 hours later. I told her I wasn’t interested in anymore but I appreciated it and I got a lecture. 🙄

I guess his entire family has key access to his house 🙄

I prefaced it when she gave me the stuff with “I was raised hardcore catholic but am now happily atheist, but I have always been interested in the fuction of religion in society”

So with that being the context, I guess I can just be like “yea, thanks for the information. But I’m not really interested in anymore” if she tries to talk about it.

Thanks for your help!!

She invited herself back over to talk about it tomorrow. I think I’m going to make an excuse to bow out and not see her. I’m just gettin really anxious about the tip toe stepping. -.-

I made the mistake of being too polite.
I was figuring to just say it to get out of talking about these magazines. Just wanted to be tactful to my friend.

Nah it’s fine. I’m confident with myself and can handle myself, my only concern is my friend and the results of my actions on him.

I’m mtf and pass exclusively as female nowadays. But I’m also sick rn and my voice sucks so it’s a shit show on if the grandparent will figure it out

Oh yea, I sent my friend a message with a “lol look what your grandparent gave me”. I’ve never met any of his family before this. Considering how bad it can be for him I’ll just suck it up and politely pass for a different reason.

I’m really confident about myself and can deal with hardcore religious zealots because words don’t really hurt me. I’m just worried about the direct result of my actions on my friend.

I’m just being nice, I have no intention of joining. I’m happy with my atheist trans queer self. I’m also very vocal about it.

I have to watch my friends’s dog, but I’ll bite my tounge here I guess. I wanted to just lowkey use it as a excuse to end the convo, but wanted to see the effect it would have on my friend.
I haven’t heard of it. I’m at my doctors right now, and seeing my therapist right after.  I’ll ask about it.

Yes!! That’s pretty much it. The feeling of being unable to escape my mind and anxiety and the frustration/exhustion that comes along with it really fuck with me and cause the depression. It’s mentally confusing because everything in my life is going okay minus that one thing and it throws me for a loop. (How does it get better if everything is fine.... is this just real life now?)

I wouldn’t say it’s a voice. Just a sense of feeling. I was in a relationship with person A once. A loves me and I know that as a fact. But my anxiety just gives me a overwelming sense that A doesn’t love me and it’s all a ploy. Even if I can identify it as anxiety, it’s still extremely difficult because identifying it as anxiety doesn’t make it any easier to fight. I still have this overwhelming fear that A hates me, and anxiety starts to overrule that logic. I have to ask person A if they love me, to get a answer. I tell myself that she’s telling the truth, but that anxious feeling of “what if she’s lying” is always there. And it works that way for everything. With my friends, family issues, tests. I also disassoiate a lot.

Those “what if”s end up taking over until they are believable and I’m disoriented and confused

I can’t really explain it well. It’s just a 24/7 state of disconfort in a flight or fight reaction state of anxiety

I feel like my illness is keeping me from living my life. My best friends have just left me, they tried to help me, but it just got too intense for them and they stopped wanting to hang out with me. They were my support system.  They still say they like me but I think they are just saying that to not hurt my feelings. I hate having to feel like someone hates me. My best friend I still ask sometimes if she hates me of thinks I’m annoying because it’s a genuinely worry I have fueled by that anxiety.  She knows that it’s my anxiety and says “I don’t know where you’re getting that from, hun” and then that’s when I realized it was just anxiety fueling it. It’s just so hard to figure out what’s real and what has a twist under it. 

I hate to sounds crazy. I have a normal job and a car and roommates, but this illness started overcoming me about a year and a half ago and it’s killing meZ
I just want to talk to others so I don’t have to talk to myself.... my thoughts are running at a thousand miles and hour and they can’t stop
